name: The Daylight Assembly
prompt: Open a circular council chamber to the street. Its roof is a fan of pearl-white solar blades that turn with the sun, casting a striped crescent of shade. A child rolls a model playground into the middle while councillors and neighbours pull their seats close to inspect it.

name: The Rain Parliament
prompt: Spread a translucent butterfly roof over a neighbourhood water board. Rain gathers at its narrow waist and drops into a working relief map of the district. Residents move bright blue gates by hand and watch a stream find its way around the model school into a planted basin.

name: The Lending Loop
prompt: Wind a ribbon of public library shelves around a citrus garden. Small orange carriers travel along the rim, lowering borrowed objects to tables set at different heights. At the broad level entrance a wheelchair user collects a telescope while two children unfold its tripod.

name: The Moving Shade Office
prompt: Give the municipal heat refuge a canopy of overlapping mint-green discs on slender powered arms. Seen from above, the discs have swung into a long scalloped band of shade from the tram stop to the drinking fountain. A street steward at the controls extends the last patch over a bench where passengers are resting.

name: The Second Life Works
prompt: Fold back the coral-coloured shell of a municipal repair hall to reveal a neighbourhood workshop. A large printing arm lays a curling bead of recycled blue plastic to form a curved seat. Beside it, residents bolt yesterday's blue seat onto a tram shelter while a mechanic shows an apprentice how the joints fit.
